docs.title: WgpArch spitfire Config
docs.text: Welcome to the official documentation for my spitfire dotfiles, featuring a custom Gold & Navy theme with 12 native workspaces and sheer transparent Waybar.

docs.title: 🎯 Quick Start
docs.text:
1. Clone this repository: git clone git@github.com:WgpArch/spitfire.git
  2. Copy configs: cp -r spitfire/configs/spitfire ~/.config/spitfire
  3. Install dependencies (see Installation)
  4. Launch spitfire from your display manager or terminal

docs.title: ✨ Key Features
docs.text:
• 12 Workspaces: Full support via number keys (1–9) and F-keys (F10–F12)
  • Gold & Navy Theme: Warm gold active borders (#d4b483) on deep navy background
  • Native Screenshots: Mod4+Shift+F3 captures full-screen with notifications
  • Rofi Integration: Custom-styled launcher and powermenu matching the aesthetic
  • Waybar Client Bar: Sheer transparent pills with workspace indicators

docs.title: 📖 Navigation
docs.text: Use the tabs above to explore installation instructions, keybinds, theming details, and the screenshot gallery. All configurations are tested and working as of November 2026.

docs.title: Core Technologies
docs.text:
• spitfire: Smithay-based dynamic tiling Wayland compositor (GitHub)
  • Waybar: Highly customizable status bar for Wayland
  • Rofi: Window switcher, application launcher, and dmenu replacement
  • grim: Screenshot utility for Wayland compositors
  • swaybg: Wallpaper setter for Wayland

docs.title: Inspiration
docs.text:
• FHT Compositor: Crimson Rain theme and 12-workspace patch served as foundational reference
  • DWM Philosophy: Minimalist, keyboard-driven workflow adapted to Lua-configurable environment
  • Material Design: Amber/gold palette inspiration for warm, accessible contrast

docs.text: Thanks to the wlroots and Smithay communities for enabling secure, performant Wayland composition. Special thanks to @dani-77 for maintaining spitfire and responding to feature requests.

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
Ensure you have the following packages installed:

```bash sudo pacman -S waybar swaybg nm-applet swaync grim libnotify rofi lxterminal Available via the AUR trizen -S paru -S yay -S spitfire

Manual installation git clone https://github.com/dani-77/spitfire.git cd spitfire sudo make install

This specific repository 1 Clone the Repository git clone git@github.com:WgpArch/spitfire.git ~/dotfiles/spitfire

2 Deploy Configuration cp -r ~/dotfiles/spitfire/configs/spitfire ~/.config/spitfire

3 Verify Directory Structure Your ~/.config/spitfire/ should contain: config.lua (main compositor config) rofi/ (launcher & powermenu scripts/styles) waybar/ (bar config & CSS) screenshots/ (auto-captured images)

4 Launch Select "spitfire" from your display manager session menu or run spitfire from a TTY.

Troubleshooting

No Waybar? Ensure paths in config.lua autostart match your actual file locations. Screenshot Fails? Verify ~/Pictures/Screenshots/spitfire/ exists and is writable. Workspace Limit? Confirm spitfire.workspace.max = 12 is set in config.lua.

docs.title: Keybindings Reference
docs.text: All keybinds use Mod4 (Super) as the primary modifier unless otherwise noted.

docs.title: Window Management
docs.text: Keybind Action Mod4 + q Close focused window Mod4 + j/k Focus next/prev window Mod4+Shift + j/k Swap next/prev window Mod4+Shift + grave Toggle scratchpad Mod4 + grave Toggle named scratch term

docs.title: Layouts
docs.text: Keybind Action Mod4 + t Tile layout Mod4 + f Fibonacci layout Mod4 + m Monocle layout Mod4+Shift + space Floating layout Mod4 + space Cycle layouts Mod4 + h/l Adjust master area size Mod4 + i/d Adjust master window count

docs.title: Workspaces
docs.text: Keybind Action Mod4 + 1-9 Focus workspace 1–9 Mod1 + 1-9 Move window to ws 1–9 Mod4 + F10-F12 Focus workspace 10–12 Mod1 + F10-F12 Move window to ws 10–12

docs.title: Utilities
docs.text: Keybind Action Mod4+Shift + F3 Screenshot + notify Mod4 + Return Launch terminal Mod4+Shift + q Quit compositor Mod4+Shift + r Reload config Mod4+Shift + V Force paste (XWayland fix)

docs.title: Media Keys
docs.text: Key Action XF86AudioRaiseVol Volume up 5% XF86AudioLowerVol Volume down 5% XF86AudioMute Toggle mute

docs.text: Role Value Usage Active Border #d4b483 Focused window highlight Inactive Bdr #414868 Unfocused windows Sheer BG rgba(30,37,50,0.85) Waybar/tooltip backgrounds Text #e8dcc5 Primary text color Hover/Accent #d4b483 Interactive element highlights Border Overlay rgba(232,220,197,0.2) Subtle border definition

docs.title: Design Principles
docs.text:
• Warm Contrast: Gold accents against deep navy create visual hierarchy without harshness
  • Sheer Transparency: Layered opacity allows wallpaper to subtly show through UI elements
  • Rounded Corners: 12px radius on borders and UI elements for soft, modern aesthetic
  • Consistent Spacing: 20px inner gaps, 10px outer gaps maintain breathing room

docs.title: Wallpaper
docs.text: Default wallpaper: /home/wgparch/Pictures/ALNW/Violin.jpg Set via swaybg -i [path] -m fill in autostart.

docs.title: Configuration Structure
docs.text:
Waybar is configured as an external client bar via spitfire.autostart():

```lua "waybar -c ~/.config/spitfire/waybar/config.jsonc -s ~/.config/spitfire/waybar/style.css"

Key Components

config.jsonc: Defines modules (workspaces, clock, weather, network, etc.) style.css: Implements the Gold & Navy theme with sheer transparency powermenu.sh: Rofi-based power menu script in rofi/ directory spitfire.rasi: Rofi styling matching Waybar's color palette

Workspace Module The workspace module uses ext-workspace-v1 protocol to display all 12 workspaces dynamically. Active workspace is highlighted with gold (#d4b483), inactive with navy (#414868).
